strategy_policy.behavior: Do not dump JSON.stringify(seoStrategy.table_strategy) into Telegram. Optionally render a short human-readable Strategy summary (headings / table titles / intent bullets) that also passes final scan.
strategy_policy.alternative_not_preferred: Sanitize raw Strategy JSON fields via repair loop and allow dump if clean

preferred_pros: Removes primary residual channel proven in smoke 3352
preferred_cons: Less transparency of machine Strategy JSON in chat
Product may want debug Strategy — resolve via admin-only /get raw later
sanitize_dump_cons: Nested JSON still hard to keep clean

qa_factcheck_summary_policy.behavior: Always show SEO QA / Factcheck verdict (+ score for QA). Include free-text summary only when that summary field passes final multi-surface scan (after repair if needed). If still dirty after repair budget → omit summary from Telegram and treat residual as block if any other public surface remains dirty; if only summary dirty and Strategy already hidden, prefer omit summary rather than block full send ONLY when operator product decision later overrides — default for this proposal: any public residual after repair BLOCKS full content send.

preferred_pros: Keeps useful QA transparency when clean
Prevents QA echo of banned phrase into Telegram (smoke residual)
preferred_cons: Summary may disappear on polluted runs

not_scanned_as_user_visible: progress Status* messages (out of this FU03 gate scope unless later chartered)
